label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter names flow directly into the format string argument of PrintWriter.printf() without effective sanitization. Although the value must match a specific constant ('BenchmarkTest00547'), the parameter name itself is user-controllable and can contain format specifiers (%), allowing a format string vulnerability to be triggered via the sink.

evidence.note: User input via parameter name flows to param, then to bar, then to printf format string sink
